isl.title: Messi Bouli’s Brace Wins It Late! | Punjab FC 2-1 Odisha FC | Quick Highlights | MG ISL 2026-27
isl.description:
Two from Bouli and three points for Punjab! Here are the quick highlights as Punjab FC beat Odisha FC 2-1 to begin their MG Indian Super League 2026-27 campaign.

Raphaël Messi Bouli struck inside the first minute and Moirangthem Thoiba Singh’s header had Odisha level by the 15th, but the Punjab striker had the final say deep into stoppage time.

Goals: 1’ Raphaël Messi Bouli (PFC) | 15’ Moirangth
